player_prompt.intro:
Aweyi kɩlaɣ {player_id} kɛ Chopsticks taa. Kpaɣa ɖoŋ, tɔŋ seɣe kɛ:
  + Kɛlɛyɛ: '[attack M O]'  ɛntɛ M=naŋgbɛŋa (0 bee 1), O=kɩlaɣ ŋgbɛŋa (0 bee 1).
    - Kɩlaɣ ŋgbɛŋa tɔɔyɛ naŋgbɛŋa; ɛɖɔɣa >=5, kɛwɛ 0.
  + Labɩyɛ: '[split L R]'  seɣe naŋgbɛŋa tɔɔyɛ L nɛ R taa (L+R = naŋgbɛŋa tɔɔyɛ).
Kɔɔ seɣe kɛlɛyɛ kɛɛkɛ.

invalid_move.split_no_change: Pɩtʋʋ fɛyɩ se Split lɛɣzʋʋ ña-tɩ.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Kɛlɛyɛ kɛɛkɛ. Tɔŋ '[attack M O]' bee '[split L R]'.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} taa P{opp_id} ɖoŋ ŋɛlɛɛ {opp_idx}: ɛyɛɛ lɛ, ɛwɛɛ kɔzɔzɔ na ɛlɛbɛna ɖɔɖɔ ɛzɩ {opp_val} mbɔ ɛlɛbɛna {new_val}.

outcome.win: Ɛyʋ weyi ɛkʋyʋʋnɩ-ŋ yɔ, e-nesi sɩba.
outcome.draw: Pɩtɛŋ lɛ, ɖɩtalɩ ɖenɖe pɩpɔzʋʋ se ɖikizi yɔ.
